# GoBag+

> GoBag+ is an iPhone and iPad app for emergency preparedness: it builds a go bag (bug-out bag, 72-hour kit) in nine categories, tracks a home reserve of water, food and medicine sized to the household, warns before items expire, keeps emergency contacts one tap away offline and stores document copies in a Face ID vault. Made by GreDami. Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760232332

The site also publishes free, sourced guides to emergency preparedness — checklists and how-tos based on official guidance (Ready.gov, the American Red Cross, Germany's BBK and other national civil-protection agencies) — in seven languages.

## App

- [Home](https://gobag.gredami.com/): Build your go bag and emergency kit with GoBag+: track supplies with expiry alerts, store SOS contacts, and secure vital documents. Free to download.
- [Pricing](https://gobag.gredami.com/pricing/): Try GoBag+ free for a month, no card needed. Then compare Premium Yearly and Lifetime: go bags, home reserve tracking, alerts and Family Sharing.
- [FAQ](https://gobag.gredami.com/faq/): Answers about go bags, emergency prep kits and GoBag+: what to pack, sizing for your household, expiry alerts, the document vault, family sync and privacy.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760232332): GoBag+ on the App Store

- [Go Bag vs Bug-Out Bag vs 72-Hour Kit: The Difference](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/go-bag-vs-bug-out-bag/): Go bag, bug-out bag, 72-hour kit, get-home bag or home kit? What each emergency kit is for, how they differ, and which ones your household actually needs.
- [Emergency Prep Kit for Beginners: Where to Start](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/prep-kit-for-beginners/): New to emergency preparedness? Six steps to your first prep kit: know your risks, make a family plan, pack a go bag, stock home supplies and keep it ready.
- [How Much Water and Food to Store for an Emergency](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/emergency-water-and-food/): How much emergency water and food to store per person: one gallon a day, a two-week home supply, what to buy, and how to rotate it before it expires.
- [Important Documents for Your Go Bag: What to Copy](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/emergency-documents/): Which important documents to keep in your emergency kit (IDs, insurance, medical and property records) and how to store paper and digital copies safely.
- [Emergency Kit Maintenance: Expiry Dates and Checks](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/emergency-kit-maintenance/): How often to check your emergency kit, how long water, food, batteries and medicine last, and a simple six-month routine to keep your go bag ready.
- [Power Outage Checklist: How to Prepare and What to Do](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/power-outage-checklist/): How to prepare for a power outage and what to do when the lights go out: a printable checklist, how long food lasts in the fridge, and generator safety.
- [Car Emergency Kit Checklist: What to Keep in Your Car](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/car-emergency-kit/): What to keep in your car for emergencies: a printable car emergency kit checklist, winter and summer extras, and what to do if you are stranded.
- [Pet Emergency Kit: Go Bag Checklist for Dogs and Cats](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/pet-emergency-kit/): What to pack in a pet emergency kit for dogs and cats: food, water, medicine, documents and carrier, plus how to plan an evacuation with your pets.
- [Go Bag for Kids and Babies: What to Pack](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/go-bag-for-kids/): How to pack an emergency go bag for babies, toddlers and school-age kids: printable checklists, an ID card for your child, and how to prepare them calmly.
- [First Aid Kit Checklist: What to Put in Your Kit](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/first-aid-kit-checklist/): A printable first aid kit checklist based on the Red Cross list for a family of four, what to add for your household, where to keep it and how to check it.
- [Family Emergency Plan: Template and Checklist](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/family-emergency-plan/): How to make a family emergency plan: the five questions to answer, meeting places, an out-of-area contact, evacuation routes and a printable checklist.
- [20 Go Bag Hacks: Lighter, Drier, Cheaper](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/go-bag-hacks/): Twenty practical go bag hacks: how to waterproof and lighten your emergency bag, a last-minute grab list, and how to build a go bag on a budget.
- [How to Use GoBag+: Set Up Your Go Bag in 10 Minutes](https://gobag.gredami.com/guides/gobag-app-guide/): A step-by-step guide to GoBag+ for iPhone and iPad: build your go bag, set up your home reserve, add SOS contacts, use the document vault and expiry alerts.

## Facts about the app

- **What is a go bag?** A go bag — also called a bug-out bag or 72-hour kit — is a portable emergency kit with the essentials you need to grab and go during a disaster or evacuation. GoBag+ helps you build one across 9 categories so nothing important is left behind.
- **What should an emergency prep kit include?** A good prep kit covers water, food, first aid, important documents, tools, shelter, communication, personal care, and cash. GoBag+ organizes all of these and adjusts the recommended quantities to how many people you're preparing for.
- **How much should I pack for my household?** It depends on how many people you are preparing for. Tell GoBag+ the size of your household, and the recommended quantities for your bag and the minimum stock levels for your home reserve adjust automatically.
- **How does GoBag+ help me build my go bag and prep kit?** GoBag+ lets you create personalized go bags across 9 categories and track every item, with your readiness shown at a glance. Targets adjust automatically to your household size, so you always know what's stocked and what's still missing.
- **Can I track home supplies and get expiry alerts?** Yes. Beyond your go bag, GoBag+ tracks your home reserve of food, water, and medicine with minimum stock levels per person, and notifies you automatically before items expire or run low.
- **Can I keep more than one go bag?** Yes. With Premium — and during the free month — you can keep up to five, one for each person or car, each organized by category.
- **Where do I keep copies of my documents?** In the Document Vault: photos and PDFs of your IDs, passports and insurance cards. It opens only with Face ID, and only you can access it.
- **What does the SOS button do?** It keeps your emergency contacts one tap away, so you can reach them instantly — even offline.
- **Is there a home-screen widget?** Yes. With Premium, a home-screen widget keeps your go bag and home reserve levels in view, so you can check your readiness at a glance.
- **Does GoBag+ sync across devices and work for my whole family?** Yes. Your bags and reserve sync across iPhone and iPad via iCloud, and Apple Family Sharing covers up to 5 members on one subscription. You can also keep IDs and passports in a Face ID–protected vault and reach emergency contacts instantly with the SOS button, even offline.
- **Which devices does GoBag+ work on?** iPhone and iPad. GoBag+ is on the App Store, and with Premium your go bags and home reserve stay in sync on every iPhone and iPad you own, through iCloud.
- **Where is my data stored?** On your device. When it syncs, it travels through Apple's encrypted iCloud — we never see your information or store it on our servers.
- **Does GoBag+ collect or sell my data?** No. The app has no analytics, no ad networks and no tracking of any kind, and it never sells your information. Purchases are handled by Apple, so we never see your payment details.
- **Is GoBag+ free?** GoBag+ is free to download, and your first month is free too: every feature, no card needed. After that, Premium Yearly or Lifetime keeps your go bags, home reserve, family sync, the home-screen widget, restoring from a backup and expiry alerts going; your emergency contacts stay free, and you can always make a backup of everything you entered.
